title: Graph Neural Networks for Resource Allocation in Integrated Sensing and Communication
abstract: arXiv:2611.07277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In vehicular integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) networks, each service-provider vehicle uses a limited power budget to serve multiple sensing targets and communication receivers. Maximizing the communication sum-rate subject to sensing signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) constraints is nonconvex, and iterative optimization is costly to rerun for every network layout. This paper proposes a graph neural network (GNN)-based power allocation algorithm, termed GNN-ISAC. Concretely, GNN-ISAC addresses the aforementioned problem by considering two distinct edge types in the graph representation, one capturing the inter-provider interference, the other representing the intra-provider power-budget sharing. GNN-ISAC is trained without labels using a sensing-penalized sum-rate loss. translated_title: 面向通感一体化的图神经网络资源分配方法
translated_abstract: 在车辆通感一体化网络中，每个服务提供车辆需在有限的功率预算下同时服务多个感知目标和通信接收端。在满足感知信号与干扰加噪声比（SINR）约束的条件下最大化通信和速率是一个非凸问题，且针对每种网络布局重新运行迭代优化算法的代价十分高昂。本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的功率分配算法，称为GNN-ISAC。具体而言，GNN-ISAC通过在图表示中考虑两种不同的边类型来解决上述问题：一种边用于刻画服务提供者之间的相互干扰，另一种边用于表示服务提供者内部的功率预算共享。GNN-ISAC采用感知惩罚的和速率损失进行无标签训练。此外，本文还通过引入感知功率预留步骤，将加权均方误差最小化（WMMSE）算法适配到该问题上。仿真……
tldr: 本文提出基于图神经网络的功率分配算法GNN-ISAC，通过在图中区分服务提供者间干扰与提供者内功率预算共享两类边，并以感知惩罚的和速率损失进行无标签训练，在满足感知SINR约束下高效最大化车辆通感一体化网络的通信和速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GNN-ISAC, a label-free graph neural network power allocation algorithm that distinguishes inter-provider interference and intra-provider power-budget sharing via two edge types in the graph, efficiently maximizing communication sum-rate under sensing SINR constraints in vehicular ISAC networks.
